$comment: Third-party plugins advertised in the srobroek-omp catalog. scripts/build-catalog.py appends these after the local packages. Every source object below was verified against the upstream repository tree: a `github` source means the repository ROOT is the plugin root, and `git-subdir` means the plugin root is a subdirectory. `ref` is pinned to the default branch and `sha` is deliberately unset, because a sha forces a full clone and no drift mechanism exists in the install path. A catalog entry is an advertisement, not a dependency: marketplace install runs no package manager, so each of these is a separate explicit install.
